critical_code_review_comments: _build_machine_svg() in server.py produces deterministic, model-branded SVGs server-side and is cleanly wired through /api/machines/{model}/image.svg with URL-encoded model names. list_machines() overrides image_url to the relative /api path so the frontend prefixes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — solid pattern, no Tennant CDN dependency, no broken Unsplash links.

Dashboard.jsx CompactVideoTile is well-scoped: localStorage persistence with 11-char YouTube ID validation, parseId() handles youtube.com/watch?v=, /embed/, /shorts/, youtu.be/, and bare IDs. aspect-video + max-h-44 keeps the tile compact in the column slot vacated by the old customs broker card.

Machines.jsx correctly prepends process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to /api/* image_urls in useEffect — confirmed by browser inspection: all 35 .src start with the preview URL and load with naturalWidth=600.
All 35 SVG endpoints respond with image/svg+xml in <50ms each (pytest 12 tests in ~6s incl. full 35-model sweep).
